config.defaultFormat.description: Default archive format used when compressing files.
config.defaultFormat.tar.gz: TAR + GZip — compressed archive with directory structure
config.defaultFormat.tar.bz2: TAR + BZip2 — high compression with directory structure
config.defaultFormat.tar.xz: TAR + XZ — best compression with directory structure
config.defaultFormat.tar.zst: TAR + Zstandard — fast compression with directory structure
config.defaultFormat.tar.lz4: TAR + LZ4 — fastest compression with directory structure
config.defaultFormat.tar.br: TAR + Brotli — high compression ratio with directory structure
config.defaultFormat.tar.sz: TAR + Snappy — fastest compression with directory structure
config.maxArchiveSize.description: Maximum size of the compressed archive file itself (including split volumes). Warning threshold when the whole archive must be loaded into memory by the WASM fallback; extraction and single-file preview can continue after confirmation. The system 7-Zip engine streams from disk and is not limited by this. Supports units: k/m/g (e.g. '100m', '1g', '500k'). Default: '1g' (= 1 GiB).
config.maxExtractTotalSize.description: Maximum total size of all files after one extraction operation. Supports units: k/m/g (e.g. '10g', '1g', '500m'). Default: '10g' (= 10 GiB).
config.collapsedDirPatterns.description: Directory name patterns to keep collapsed by default in the archive preview.
config.compressExcludePatterns.descripti: Glob patterns (gitignore syntax) for files/directories to exclude when compressing.
config.volumeSizes.description:
Custom split volume size presets (label → value).

**Keys**: display labels shown in the size picker (e.g. `"650M"`, `"1.44M"`).

**Values**: must be a **positive integer** followed by a **unit**:
- `k` — KiB (e.g. `"1440k"`)
- `m` — MiB (e.g. `"25m"`, `"100m"`)
- `g` — GiB (e.g. `"1g"`, `"2g"`)

Decimals and negative numbers are not valid (e.g. `"1.5m"`, `"-100m"` ✗).

Leave empty `{}` to use the built-in presets.
config.backend.7z.description: Which 7-Zip engine to use for compress/decompress. The extension bundles a native 7-Zip ZS (mcmilk fork with FLZMA2/ZSTD); a system install or the WASM engine can be selected instead. Native is significantly faster and uses less memory than WASM.
config.backend.7z.auto: Use the bundled 7-Zip ZS when available; a system 7-Zip is used only when it is at least as capable (e.g. another ZS build). Platforms without a bundled binary (e.g. macOS x64) use the WASM engine.
config.backend.7z.native: Always use system 7-Zip. Show an error if 7-Zip is not installed or too old.
config.backend.7z.bundled: Always use the 7-Zip binary bundled with this extension, ignoring any system installation. Falls back to the WASM engine if the bundled binary is unavailable for this platform.
config.backend.7z.wasm: Never use a native 7-Zip (system or bundled). Always use the bundled WASM engine, even if a native 7-Zip is available.
config.backend.zstd.description: Which backend to use for tar.zst compression and decompression.
config.backend.zstd.auto: Detect system zstd automatically. If found, use it for faster tar.zst compression; otherwise fall back to the bundled 7zz binary, then WASM.
config.backend.zstd.native: Always use system zstd. Show an error if zstd is not installed.
config.backend.zstd.bundled: Use the bundled native 7zz binary, ignoring any system zstd install. Falls back to WASM if unavailable.
config.backend.zstd.wasm: Always use the WASM engine, even if system zstd or the bundled binary is available.
config.backend.brotli.description: Which engine to use for brotli (.br / tar.br) compression and decompression.
config.backend.brotli.auto: Use the best available native implementation (Node.js zlib).
config.backend.brotli.native: Node.js built-in zlib — native, no WASM heap.
config.backend.brotli.bundled: Bundled native 7-Zip binary (standard brotli streams). Falls back to Node zlib if unavailable.
config.backend.lz4.description: Which engine to use for lz4 (.lz4 / tar.lz4) compression and decompression.
config.backend.lz4.auto: Use the bundled native 7zz binary when available, otherwise the WASM engine.
config.backend.lz4.bundled: Always use the bundled native 7zz binary. Falls back to WASM if unavailable.
config.backend.lz4.wasm: Always use the WASM engine, even if the bundled binary is available.
config.sevenZipMethod.description: Compression method for new .7z archives. FLZMA2 (default) is standard-LZMA2-compatible and much faster to compress. The bundled 7-Zip ZS supports ZSTD/Brotli/LZ4/Lizard too; stock 7-Zip only reads LZMA2/Deflate/BZip2/… so pick LZMA2 for maximum portability. For .xz/.tar.xz, FLZMA2 maps to the HC4 fast-LZMA2 variant (much faster, slightly larger) and LZMA2 keeps the standard encoder.
config.sevenZipMethod.flzma2: Fast LZMA2 (default) — LZMA2-compatible, 20–100% faster compression (HC4 match finder for .xz/.tar.xz).
config.sevenZipMethod.lzma2: Stock LZMA2 — widest compatibility, best ratio.
config.sevenZipMethod.zstd: Zstandard — very fast; requires a 7-Zip ZS build (bundled native/WASM both support it).
config.sevenZipMethod.brotli: Brotli — best ratio for text; requires the bundled 7-Zip ZS.
config.sevenZipMethod.deflate: Deflate — the ZIP-family method; wide compatibility.
config.sevenZipMethod.bzip2: BZip2 — classic block compressor; slower, good ratio.
config.sevenZipMethod.lizard: Lizard — very fast decompression; levels 0–9 are mapped onto LizardMT's 10–49 scale.
config.workerMemoryMb.description: Memory ceiling (MiB) for the archive worker thread, which runs WASM 7-Zip. 0 disables the guard. Lower it to reduce the extension's memory footprint; raise it if large archives fail with a memory-limit error.
config.workerPoolSize.description: Number of archive worker threads. 1 serializes all operations (lowest memory); 2 allows batch operations on small archives to run in parallel. Each worker holds its own WASM 7-Zip heap. Requires a window reload to take effect.
config.logLevel.description: Verbosity of the Smart Archiver output channel logs.
config.cache.maxPreviewMB.description: Largest single file (MB) the preview cache will hold. Larger previews stay in the session temp dir and are deleted when their tab closes. 0 disables the persistent cache.
config.cache.ttlDays.description: Days a cached preview survives without being previewed again.
config.cache.maxMB.description: Total disk budget (MB) for the preview cache. Deduplicated copies count once.
config.cache.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files in the preview cache.
config.logHistoryBytes.description: Memory budget (bytes) for the log history buffer used to re-render the output panel when the log level changes. Larger budgets keep more log lines available.
config.backend.rar.description: Which RAR5 creation engine to use. The bundled native binding is faster and uses less memory; the WASM engine covers platforms without a native binary.
config.backend.rar.auto: Use the native Node binding when available; fall back to the WASM engine otherwise (default).
config.backend.rar.native: Always use the native Node binding. Show an error if it is unavailable for this platform.
config.backend.rar.wasm: Always use the WASM engine, even if the native binding is available.
config.backend.snappy.description: Which snappy implementation to use for tar.sz. The native Node addon is faster; the WASM engine covers platforms without a native binary.
config.backend.snappy.auto: Use the native Node addon when available; fall back to the WASM engine otherwise (default).
config.backend.snappy.native: Always use the native Node addon. Show an error if it is unavailable.
config.backend.snappy.wasm: Always use the WASM engine, even if the native addon is available.
